subject: Saturday clean-up day needs volunteers by tomorrow evening
text: The Saturday clean-up day has been confirmed for this weekend, but the notice is arriving later than I wanted, so as your organizer I am asking you, neighbor, directly because we have a tight deadline. I need twenty neighbors at the north gate by eight fifteen in the morning, and we must finish bagging, hauling, and raking before noon, when the collection truck passes. Please bring gloves if you have them, because we will have fewer than the usual supply of loaner pairs. I will provide trash bags, brooms, and one hand truck, though we still need anyone able to spare a large bucket or a folding crate for moving loose debris. Do not worry about sorting recyclables; we will keep those in separate blue bags and label them later. The only restriction is that no one should remove anything from the old shed behind the bench, since the council wants an inspection first. If you cannot attend but can set out chairs near the parking strip by eight o'clock, that would still help. I will send a reminder tonight, but if your plans change, let me know before seven tomorrow evening so I can cover the gap. Please wear closed shoes, keep children away from the fence line, and bring a bottle of water if you have one; I will refill the jug at the gate and remove it after the truck leaves. If you have a lift, mention it. Thank you for considering this on such short notice.
